title: Satellites shake over Roraima's rare earths

tellings.quote: So it is believed that when these American satellites that can perform these scannings searching for minerals all over the planet when they cross over the state of Hima, the signal is so strong from the presence of rare earth that the satellite shakes violently almost to the point of dropping

plain: When American satellites that scan the planet for minerals pass over the Brazilian state of Roraima, the signal from its rare earths is said to be so strong that the satellites shake violently, almost to the point of falling. Brazil's former defense minister Aldo Rebelo tells Michels this as something that "is believed", not as something he saw, and if true it would mean the state sits on unusually rich deposits of these valuable minerals.
